about_the_game:
Welcome to Cyber Hearts Club – a brutal battlefield where only the strongest survive. In this action-packed team-based shooter, you’ll fight across war-torn cities and abandoned ruins in a world ravaged by the apocalypse.

Choose from a variety of unique classes, each with their own weapons and abilities, and engage in fast-paced combat against players or AI-controlled enemies. Whether you prefer close-quarters chaos or long-range precision, teamwork is the key to victory.

Features:

  • Team-based PvP battles – Fight alongside allies in strategic multiplayer combat.

  • Offline mode – Take on AI opponents and sharpen your skills.

  • Diverse classes – Pick a role that suits your playstyle, from heavy firepower to agile assassins.

  • Post-apocalyptic world – Battle in dystopian environments full of danger and decay.

Join the fight. Earn your place in Cyber Hearts Club!

content_descriptors.notes: Not recommended for sensitive people, may cause nausea or panic attack.
